# Grantlore

> Free directory of 6,521 U.S. private foundations built from IRS Form 990-PF e-filings (tax years mostly 2024-2025; site built 2026-10-29). Each profile lists total assets, grants paid, the itemized grant list, typical (median) grant, geographic focus, and application instructions or "preselected only" status from Part XV, with a link to the source filing on ProPublica.

## Key pages
- [Search all foundations](https://grantlore.com/): filter by state, cause keyword, typical grant size, application status
- [Foundations by state](https://grantlore.com/states/)
- [Foundations by cause](https://grantlore.com/causes/)
- [Trade training grants 2026](https://grantlore.com/trade-training-grants/): verified scholarships, employer and nonprofit programs
- [Foundations funding trades & workforce training](https://grantlore.com/foundations-funding-trades-training/)
- [Methodology & data sources](https://grantlore.com/methodology.html)
- [About](https://grantlore.com/about.html)

## Notes
- Foundation profile URLs: https://grantlore.com/f/<EIN>-<name>.html
- Data is public IRS record; always verify with the funder before applying.
